title: Dance with the Voice of Destiny!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Quite a few days have passed since forming a contract with Epiphaneia.
Our dynamic, where I used to constantly get left behind, has begun to shift.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A new routine? Forget that, let's do shuttle runs!
The voice of destiny says this'll be the most effective right now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: DORYAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A meeting?
Yeah, absolutely! Let's do it right—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Wait, never mind! Changed my mind!
I just realized there's something I gotta tell that girl over there!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Can you spare me a moment of your time?!
I want to grant you the "Voice of Destiny"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —iner... Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What's with the blank stare? What's up?
You didn't even notice I was here—
choice_data_list: I was just reminiscing about when we first signed... Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's go for a run outside!
There's something I want to test out!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The voice of destiny says right now is the time!
Come on, let's go! Right now! Hurry, hurry!
choice_data_list: A-Alright! Hold on while I get ready...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, hop in that rickshaw over there!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's a form of resistance training!
I'm gonna pull you while I run!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It'll build my core, and this way, I won't leave you in the dust, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words remind me of the time she completely
left me behind while I was trying to keep pace on a bicycle.
choice_data_list: Ah... I panicked pretty hard back then.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haha, my bad, okay?! Come on, let's give it a whirl!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a great workout!
...Whoops, looks like my stomach's starting to roar!
choice_data_list: Shall we grab a bite on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a plan! ...Oh, let's hit that ramen joint in the shopping district!
I wanna take on their challenge bowl! The voice of destiny is telling me to go for it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Look, yours is here too! The Mega-Ramen: Human Edition!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While smaller than the portion served to the horsegirl in front of me,
it's still an intimidating mountain of food.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine! You've got plenty of guts, Trainer. And best of all,
I'm here telling you we can do it together! Come on, let's give it our all!
choice_data_list: You're right... I'll give it a shot!
You're right... I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Clean plate challenge: complete, babyyy!!
See?! Told ya it'd be fine, Trainer!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! I think your energy rubbed off on me.
Yeah! I think your energy rubbed off on me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you can slurp ramen right down, so it's super easy to eat—I love it!
Though your last-minute sprint was pretty cool too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sense of accomplishment fills my chest.
...Along with a sudden, overwhelming wave of fullness.
choice_data_list: Mind if we take a break? ...I feel like I'm gonna burst.
Mind if we take a break? ...I feel like I'm gonna burst.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Really? In that case, I know something way better than resting.
Post-meal exercise! Let's sing together!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! There's even an open stage right there!
You know all my solo tracks by heart, don't you? Come on, come on!
choice_data_list: I mean, I know them, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's just the two of us here! Let's sing our hearts out!
The voice of destiny says we should go for it too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Giving in and singing along turns out to be surprisingly cathartic.
Having her right beside me, enjoying every second from the bottom of her heart, certainly helps.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
See, wasn't that awesome?
You were totally getting into the groove halfway through!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright! Let's head home, then!
After singing with all our might, I bet we'll sleep like a log tonight!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... we were in top form all day today!
Don't you think so, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our daily routine has taken on a new shape—
She's no longer tearing ahead all by herself.
choice_data_list: Getting to spend time together like this really makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what was that face just now?! That was amazing!!
Can you do it one more time?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The one you just made! I wanna see it again!
Come on, please, do it right now, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia kept begging me for quite a while after that,
but I couldn't recreate it.
